independent_scoring_reference.locator: Utts review,PDF29,printed3-8 (visually checked); executive summary PDF2–6; Hyman review independent judging/replication discussion.
independent_scoring_reference.factual_notes: Utts describes preselected target sets, known random selection probabilities, and a blind judge ranking five candidates: one actual and four decoys. Each candidate must have equal prior selection probability; rank1 is closest. AIR distinguishes statistical findings from attribution, reports judge/target concerns and limited operational utility. Utts and Hyman differ on interpretation; neither a rank implementation nor a historical program proves ESP. Hyman emphasizes independent judging and replication.
independent_scoring_reference.source_vs_proposal: Five-choice blind ranking is source-backed. The cryptographic workflow, file schema and conservative inference restrictions below are editorial software design, not an authenticated historical protocol.
independent_scoring_reference.limits: Descriptive post-reveal resemblance is commentary, not the blind rank. No invented embedding/LLM match metric is certified as historical or validated scientific scoring.

proposed_first_executable_scope.offline: Local files and existing standard-library hashing/JSON only. Separate tasker and viewer/judge accounts or physical machines/hand-carried packets for real blinding. Same-workspace owner can inspect private files; software must flag this limitation, not claim access control. No cloud/secret API/image generation or downloaded target dataset required.
proposed_first_executable_scope.randomization: Future real assignments use private OS entropy with unbiased uniform choice; private algorithm/assignment log supports replay after reveal. Fixed seeds belong only in labeled simulated fixtures. Manual assignments can be logged but must not receive randomized/chance-qualified status. Whole five-item candidate set is fixed before actual target selection; decoys cannot be handpicked afterward.
proposed_first_executable_scope.commitment: Domain-separated canonical UTF-8 preimage binds trial, protocol, pool/version, target asset digest, assignment and private high-entropy nonce. Publish digest before session; disclose preimage only after judge lock. Unsalted low-entropy target IDs are guessable. A digest detects mismatch under cryptographic assumptions, not secret access, honest clocks, independent observers or unlogged alternative commitments.
proposed_first_executable_scope.timing: Require explicit timezone timestamps and ordered event counters; assignment commitment < session start <= transcript lock < blind judge lock < authorized reveal <= feedback. Clock order is a recorded assertion, not independently proven elapsed time. Resolve no missing/conflicting timestamps by inference. Training in-session feedback is retained as a separate unblinded mode, ineligible for blind-evaluation metrics.
proposed_first_executable_scope.state_and_conflicts: Reject premature/duplicate reveal, wrong pool/protocol/asset/digest, transcript mutation, target absent from candidates, duplicate target aliases or ranks, unrecorded reassignment, and incompatible event/knowledge declarations. Preserve rejected records. Target reuse policy and full trial history are committed; never silently choose a successful attempt.
proposed_first_executable_scope.leakage: Allowlist packet fields. Use fresh opaque names; remove paths, EXIF, thumbnails, alt text, captions, timestamps, sidecar metadata and actual-target flags before sealing sanitized assets. Hash the exact sanitized bytes, not only the originals. Equal rendering and candidate order policies are fixed. Check explicit packet content; no automated scan can certify absence of all contextual/semantic leakage, tasker collusion or participant prior knowledge.
proposed_first_executable_scope.immutability: Append-only event hashes make recorded edits detectable relative to a retained commitment; local owner can rewrite all files. Trusted independent witness/external timestamping is optional P1, not a claim of present tamper resistance.

proposed_scoring_and_benchmarks.arithmetic: For five uniformly assigned candidates and fixed strict ranks1..5, top-rank null probability1/5 and expected rank3. Independently enumerate all5! target/order rank permutations before implementation. General K formulas (K+1)/2 and1/K are editorial arithmetic, not new empirical standards.
proposed_scoring_and_benchmarks.conservative_scope: First release can report exact per-trial rank, hit count, mean rank and declared null expectations. Inferential p-values only after independent verification of sampling model; otherwise explicitly unavailable. Reject ties initially instead of post-hoc tie resolution.
proposed_scoring_and_benchmarks.base_rates: Unequal selection probabilities, without-replacement pools, reused targets and correlated sessions invalidate naive independent binomial assumptions. Require declared probabilities and an appropriate precommitted randomization/permutation model or withhold inferential outputs.
proposed_scoring_and_benchmarks.multiple_comparisons: Predeclare candidate count, judging, primary endpoint, number of trials, stopping rule and exclusions. Retain every trial and alternative target/pool attempted. No best-judge/best-target/best-window search or success-only reporting. Multiple judges are not extra independent trials.
proposed_scoring_and_benchmarks.human_judgment: Keep each independent judge’s complete ranking and disagreement. Any aggregation must be prespecified and separately verified; no averaging secretly changed after reveal. Human resemblance notes and LLM simulations cannot be promoted to objective target truth.
proposed_scoring_and_benchmarks.benchmark: Synthetic zero-information transcripts, known assignments and enumerated uniform relabelings test arithmetic and procedural rejection only. Actual blinded human trials would require a separate preregistered empirical study and rights/consent practices; none run or claimed here. A procedural pass establishes neither paranormal ability nor useful forecasting.
